A '''raid''' was executed on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Quadanium steel/Legends|quadanium steel]] shipment by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[Jyn Freila's squadron|squadron]] under the command of [[Jyn Freila]]. The raid ended poorly for the Rebel [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] leaving most of them [[Death/Legends|dead]] and Freila without an [[Eye/Legends|eye]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
